# History

History lists recent requests so you can open the data from any of them, not just the current page.

<!-- screenshot: history.png generated by e2e -->
![The History panel listing HTML, JSON and SSE requests](../assets/screenshots/history.png)

## How it works

- Lens keeps finished requests in an in-memory ring buffer. The default size is 50 (`history.maxRequests`).
- When the buffer is full, Lens recycles the oldest request.
- History is not persisted. A restart clears it.
- Each row shows the type, status, time and issue count.

## Non-HTML requests

JSON, SSE, file and redirect responses get no bar. With `history.trackNonHtml` on (the default), Lens still collects them and returns the request id in the `X-BxLens-Id` header. They then appear in History. This helps when you debug an API or an ajax call.

```bash
curl -i http://localhost:8080/api/users
# X-BxLens-Id: 7f3c...
```

!!! note
    Whether History survives an app reinit is an open item in the spec. Treat it as in-memory for the life of the runtime process.

Comparing two requests is planned. See the [Roadmap](../project/roadmap.md).
